inputs.p2: P2Predictor().fit(ledger, FeatureSpace.fit(ledger), P1Predictor().fit(ledger), guard=multiplier); admitted = selected lambda above zero in a cell; off = guard=None, the earlier rule

inputs.note: 11,100 tests was not run: each fit takes minutes at that size

inputs.gain: best candidate lambda above zero (the one the guard tests): mean per-row log-score gain over lambda 0, leave-one-test-out rows
inputs.rows_per_cell: mean visible rows of the cell at the fit

inputs.candidate: the best positive-weight candidate (weight, bandwidth, half-life), refit alone for its cell, scored on held-out rows
inputs.held_out: a random share of the tests, never rows
inputs.held_out_gain: mean per-row log score of P2 minus P1 on the held-out rows, nats; its standard error is clustered by test
inputs.standard_errors: root of the sum of squared per-cell standard errors over the number of cells (cells independent)

inputs.in_selection_gain: mean per-row log-score gain over lambda 0 on the leave-one-test-out validation rows of the fit
inputs.unit: nats per row of log score

inputs.decisive: the row's own realized |y| above z times its realized standard error (the harness's decisive rows)
inputs.difference: P2 log score minus P1 log score on the same row, nats; P2 better = difference above zero
inputs.event: the row's own realized y above z times its realized standard error (the significant-positive event)
inputs.intervals: percentile intervals by test from one set of resamples per pair (and one for the pooled rows); medians by weighted median
inputs.refit: P1 and P2 refit at each admitted origin with harness.default_rungs on ledger.visible_rows, the report's p2_guard

inputs.mean_rows_in_period_level: rows of the period whose level P1 adds to every cell at the fit date (0: none, as in the no-period arm)
inputs.new_rule: P1 fit with the default data end (the newest usable_after): partial tail periods set no level
inputs.old_rule: P1 fit with every period counted (data_end far in the future)
inputs.old_rule_no_period: the old rule with the period fit of every period replaced by the global fit

differences_from_docs: guard_admission_rates: the one-off runs behind the documentation left no report file, so the cells are refit here on ledgers regenerated with the same generator, text effect zero, 300 tests of two variants per seed; the seeds and the settings are in inputs

top_m_tail_share: the ledgers of 1e4 and 3e5 contrasts were not kept, so they are regenerated by benchmark.make_scale_ledger with the benchmark's seed; 1e5 reads the scale ledger when it exists; the 60 queries are drawn here with the seed in inputs

inputs.exposure: mean of n_ref and n_var, natural log

inputs.diff_vs_p1: mean per-row difference from P1 of the log score (nats) and of the Brier score of p_sig (negative is better); intervals by test from one set of resamples per cell
inputs.ledger: the ledger of each folder read as a data root, storage_paths(run).ledger_path (moot simulate ledger --text-effect)
inputs.oracle: P1 refit at every origin on the visible rows (data end = origin) with the planted term removed, its location moved back by the row's term (method call 230); brier_skill against P0 on the same rows
inputs.recovered_fraction: a rung's difference from P1 over the oracle's, in log score and in Brier score
inputs.rows: the rows P1 scored; every other rung is read on the same rows

runs.command: moot backtest --source synthetic --origins quarterly --challenger gbm --challenger local_eb --challenger text_lr --seed 0
moot backtest --source synthetic --origins quarterly --challenger gbm --challenger local_eb --challenger text_lr --seed 0

inputs.brier_skill: 1 minus the mean Brier of p_sig over P0's on the held-out rows, P0 fit on the fit rows; the event is y > z s
inputs.cells: the default synthetic cells and their tau
inputs.held_out: a random share of the tests, never rows; P1, the feature space, P2, P0 and the oracle are fit on the rest
inputs.oracle_gain: P1 refit on the fit rows with the planted term strength * (signal - 0.5) removed from y, its location moved back by the row's term; mean held-out log score minus P1's (method call 230)
inputs.realized_gain: mean held-out log score of P2 minus P1 per row, nats; interval and standard error by test, pooled over seeds and cells
inputs.recovered_fraction: realized_gain over oracle_gain; its interval is the ratio of the paired by-test draws
inputs.share_admitted: P2 fit on the whole ledger (guard = multiplier); admitted = selected lambda above zero in a cell

inputs.origin: one day after the last usable_after
inputs.queries: random headlines of 3 to 8 words from the benchmark word list, no image change, planned exposure 5000 to 60000

inputs.definition: rows abstained in the main run and issued in the run without the trigger
